progress.param: Receives the progress, if it isn't needed. calls its handler on the it was created on, so UI apps can update their controls in it.

remarks.para: The SDK calls on one of its threads, one call at a time, and waits for it: it must return quickly and must not wait for the task the helper returned. It is never called once the returned task completed, a handler posted before can still run afterwards. The progress is informational: the SDK skips updates when the receiver falls behind and can drop the last one when the operation finishes, the returned task tells when and how it finished.
An exception thrown by ends the reporting, it doesn't abort the operation. The returned task throws it once the operation finished, unless the operation failed itself.
